verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a reasonable thing to ask of a SaaS feedback platform, so the story applies. However, the evidence pack documents only a JavaScript SDK, an API reference, widgets, integrations and an MCP server, with no mention of an official command-line tool. The MCP server and API are adjacent capabilities, not a CLI, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
